inference_limit: Only the declared simulated throw distribution and fixed controller; not hardware or training seed reliability. Development and confirmation provenance must be reported separately.
impact_note: Sums of allowed hand contact normal magnitudes from the unchanged anatomical recorder; not net force or a calibrated injury estimate. Initial impact is time aligned separately in each trial.
prerelease_audit_correction: Full1kHz state trace used. Original anatomical recorder has no prerelease rows; V1None meant missing coverage, not motion. No score or outcome changed.
inferential_status: Descriptive development estimates only; these throws were previously examined and informed development. Confirmation evidence must be reported separately.
